rationale: Codex's plan is the only one that covers both agent clones and coordinator-created worktrees with a mechanism verified to work (mirror-local user.* that evidence commits still override), whereas antigravity's extensions.worktreeConfig on the bare mirror makes every linked worktree bare and breaks evidence commits (independently reproduced by claude and codex reviews) and claude's plan omits the issue's required worktree coverage, leaving codex's remaining defects (in-install gh lookup, shared-mirror account switch edge) correctable in implementation.
